CVE-2026-100252.title: Apache ZooKeeper: SASL authorization bypass on the client port through a client-supplied authorization ID
CVE-2026-100252.description:
Improper Authorization vulnerability in Apache ZooKeeper.

When SASL authentication is enabled on the client port, the server's SASL callback handler grants every authorization identity (authzid) that a client requests, without checking it against the principal the client authenticated as. The server then tries to replace the requested identity with a canonical form of the authenticated principal, derived from the zookeeper.security.auth_to_local rules. If no rule applies to the principal, canonicalization fails and the error is only logged. The client-requested authzid then becomes the session's SASL identity for all ACL checks.

An authenticated client whose principal is not covered by the auth_to_local rules can therefore claim any SASL identity. With the default rules, this includes any Kerberos principal from a realm other than the server's default realm, such as a principal from a cross-realm trusted realm. The client then gets the permissions granted to that identity in sasl…

CVE-2026-107190.title: Path Traversal in Bludit
CVE-2026-107190.description:
Bludit is vulnerable to Path Traversal in the page deletion functionality. An authenticated user with the Author role can set the UUID field of their own page to contain path traversal sequences (.. and path separators), which are saved without proper validation. When the page is deleted, Pages::delete() passes the path constructed from this UUID to Filesystem::deleteRecursive() without verifying that it still points to an allowed directory, allowing the attacker to delete any files, even not belonging to them. Critically, it is possible to delete admin pages and render the site unusable.

Because vendor contact attempts were unsuccessful, the vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.22.0 but may also affect other versions.

CVE-2026-62965.title: SABnzbd: Orphan-job path traversal permits arbitrary file deletion
CVE-2026-62965.description: SABnzbd is an open source automated Usenet download tool. Prior to 5.1.0Beta3, orphan-job management in `sabnzbd/api.py` accepts the user-controlled `value` parameter without path confinement before `os.path.join()` with `download_dir`. An absolute path discards that base directory. An attacker with a valid API key can invoke `mode=status` with `name=delete_orphan` to reach `_api_delete_orphan` and `remove_all()` in `sabnzbd/filesystem.py`, which uses `shutil.rmtree()` for recursive deletion. The advisory also identifies `_api_add_orphan` and `_api_delete_all_orphan` as affected by the path-validation issue, while its concrete arbitrary-deletion trace is through `_api_delete_orphan`. The API key is stored in plaintext in `sabnzbd.ini`. The attacker can delete files or directories writable by the SABnzbd process, including configuration, queue data, and downloads, but system files outside the regular user's ownership are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 5.1.0Beta3.

CVE-2026-77314.description: Flyto2 Core is an execution kernel for automation and AI-agent workflows. CVE-2026-99619.title: drm/amdgpu: don't drop the gang dependency fence twice
CVE-2026-99619.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/amdgpu: don't drop the gang dependency fence twice

drm_sched_job_add_dependency() drops the fence reference when it fails,
but amdgpu_cs_submit() drops it again, so the scheduled fence of a gang
member loses a reference it still needs.

A GFX+COMPUTE gang waiting for another context, with the
xarray node allocation for the leader's dependency failed through
failslab:

WARNING: drivers/dma-buf/dma-fence.c:589 at dma_fence_release+0x34d/0x730, CPU#1: amd_uapi_regres/2993
drm_sched_job_cleanup+0x2c2/0x340 [gpu_sched]
amdgpu_job_free+0xcb/0x3e0 [amdgpu]
amdgpu_cs_parser_fini+0x435/0x710 [amdgpu]
amdgpu_cs_ioctl+0xcd2/0x7a60 [amdgpu]
Oops: general protection fault, probably for non-canonical address 0xdffffc0000000001: 0000 [#1] SMP KASAN NOPTI
KASAN: null-ptr-deref in range [0x0000000000000008-0x000000000000000f]

CVE-2026-9797.title: Keycloak: keycloak: privilege escalation via client authentication manipulation by an authenticated administrator
CVE-2026-9797.description: A flaw was found in Keycloak's administrative services (org.keycloak.services.resources.admin). A highly privileged attacker, authenticated with a 'manage-clients' role, could exploit this vulnerability through several methods, including manipulating client JSON Web Key Sets (JWKS), swapping client authenticator types and resetting secrets, or downloading legitimate signing keys. Successful exploitation allows the attacker to obtain a token with 'realm-admin' role assignments, leading to privilege escalation and potential unauthorized access to sensitive resources.
